mod.name: Arranger: Zoom Toggle
mod.author: Silent Orbit
mod.description: One shortcut (set it in Settings > Shortcuts, action 'Zoom to Fit Selection (Toggle)') hides the clip launcher (if shown), zooms to the selection in time AND makes the selected track tall; press it again to go back and show the launcher again. Arranger only. Needs Framework: Actions and Menus.
